youtube-matching.title: YouTube: How Content ID works
youtube-matching.finding: Uploads are matched against submitted reference files; this review did not access that reference database or scan a rendered recording.

youtube-claims.title: YouTube: Copyright claims versus removal requests
youtube-claims.finding: Content ID claims and copyright-removal requests are different processes; a claim is not itself a copyright strike.

youtube-reference.title: YouTube: Content eligible for Content ID
youtube-reference.finding: References require exclusive rights and sufficiently distinctive material. Nonexclusive third-party content and production loops raise reference-eligibility issues, independently of upload permission.

youtube-disputes.title: YouTube: Learn about Content ID claims
youtube-disputes.finding: Review a claim before responding; disputes need a valid basis and may escalate.

us-ai-authorship.title: U.S. Copyright Office: Copyright and artificial intelligence findings
us-ai-authorship.finding: AI assistance does not automatically bar protection, but U.S. protection requires qualifying human expression, not merely supplying prompts. This is not a rule for every jurisdiction.

strudel-synth.title: Strudel: Synthesizers
strudel-synth.finding: Documents basic waveforms and generated noise. These are distinct from external recordings, soundfonts and sample-backed wavetables.

strudel-prebake.title: Strudel: Default REPL sound registration
strudel-prebake.finding: Identifies Salamander piano and registers piano, VCSL and tidal-drum-machines separately. Runtime mappings can change.

drum-readme.title: tidal-drum-machines: Repository and playback instructions
drum-readme.finding: The former ritchse repository redirects here. Playback instructions do not establish the original recording source or a sample-data permission grant.

drum-license-question.title: tidal-drum-machines: Open license clarification issue
drum-license-question.finding: The inspected issue requests clarification for code and sample files and had no response. An unanswered question is not a rights grant.

dough-samples.title: Strudel sample collection: Sources and credits
dough-samples.finding: Identifies Salamander as CC BY and VCSL as CC0, but only links tidal-drum-machines. VCSL's CC0 label cannot be transferred to the drum banks.

salamander-source.title: FreePats: Salamander Grand Piano
salamander-source.finding: Documents Alexander Holm's Salamander piano, CC BY 3.0 and V3 downloads.

cc-by.title: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
cc-by.finding: Allows commercial sharing and adaptation subject to its terms, including attribution. It is not a ShareAlike license; no musical-render attribution waiver was established.

gm-map.title: Strudel: General MIDI soundfont preset map
gm-map.finding: Index 1 selects 0040_FluidR3_GM_sf2_file for gm_epiano1 and 0320_FluidR3_GM_sf2_file for gm_acoustic_bass in the inspected map.

font-loader.title: Strudel: WebAudioFont loader
font-loader.finding: The inspected default loader uses the Felix Roos WebAudioFont data host; a working download is not independently a license grant.

fluid-readme.title: FluidR3: Upstream README preserved in Debian source
fluid-readme.finding: Frank Wen explicitly releases Fluid under the MIT license and describes contributions to its sample collection.

fluid-license.title: FluidR3: Upstream MIT permission notice
fluid-license.finding: Requires retention of the copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions. Debian packaging licenses are separate from the upstream soundfont license.

webaudiofont-sources.title: WebAudioFont data: Separate upstream soundfont licenses
webaudiofont-sources.finding: Links separate source licenses for FluidR3 and other banks. Its repository license alone does not prove the entire original-binary-to-preset permission chain.

synth.verdict: Lower identified third-party sample exposure; actual automated-claim likelihood is unknown.
synth.rationale: No external sample recordings are identified in this score's instrument inventory. That removes the particular drum-bank and piano/soundfont clearance issues found elsewhere in the collection. It does not establish musical uniqueness, copyright ownership, or that a platform will never match a passage to somebody else's recording.
synth.inventory: Built-in oscillator synthesis and/or generated noise, using the cue's sine, triangle, square or white-noise voices rather than a third-party drum bank, piano recording or GM soundfont. Water effects are synthesized; no cassette dialogue recording is embedded. This assumes the normal Strudel sound registrations have not been overridden.
synth.licensing: No track-specific third-party sample attribution obligation was identified from that inventory. A basic waveform is not being treated as a copied commercial recording. This assessment does not clear a composition's melodic resemblance, newly added assets, or all software/distribution obligations.
actions: Keep the synthesized instrumentation if you want to retain this lower sample-provenance exposure; reassess any replacement with recorded samples.
Do not infer exclusive Content ID eligibility from a synth-only arrangement. Related motifs in this collection, sufficient distinctiveness and qualifying human authorship still need consideration.
synth.bottom_line: Fewer identified sample-rights concerns than the sampled tracks, but neither claim-proof nor independently cleared for every upload.

tr707.verdict: Additional unresolved sample-licensing exposure; actual automated-claim likelihood is unknown.
tr707.rationale: The composition is an original AI-assisted score, but its shared RolandTR707 percussion adds a rights question that the synth-only cues do not have. Research did not establish the actual drum recordings' original source or an applicable sample-data permission grant. This is a documentation gap, not a finding that the samples are infringing or that a particular drum hit will trigger a fingerprint match.
tr707.inventory: RolandTR707 kick, rim and hi-hat recordings selected through Strudel's drum bank, alongside synthesized tonal voices, water effects and, where used, generated noise. The collection contains source patterns, not copied drum sample binaries or a commercial-song recording.
tr707.licensing: The tidal-drum-machines repository explains playback but does not establish permission for these sample files; its inspected license-clarification issue remained unanswered. Neither CC0 nor a fully verified mixed-license inventory was established. CC0 credits for the neighboring VCSL library do not apply automatically to this bank. Attribution alone does not cure missing permission.
actions: Before describing a rendered release as fully cleared, obtain an explicit permission/provenance statement for the actual RolandTR707 recordings, or replace them with self-synthesized percussion or clearly licensed recordings. The archived music has not been altered to make that choice for you.
Do not enroll the recording as an exclusive Content ID reference merely because the composition is original. Shared samples require a separate reference-eligibility assessment.
tr707.bottom_line: Preserved as written, with the TR707 sample-permission question explicitly unresolved; no defensible claim percentage is available.

tr909.verdict: Additional unresolved sample-licensing exposure; actual automated-claim likelihood is unknown.
tr909.rationale: This is the original four-bar Eurodance teaching example, not a supplied transcription of a commercial song. Its shared RolandTR909 percussion nevertheless has an unverified original recording source and sample-permission chain. Genre resemblance and stated original intent are not an independent melody-similarity clearance. No claim probability can be inferred from the short loop or its style.
tr909.inventory: RolandTR909 kick, snare and hi-hat recordings; synthesized sawtooth bass and lead; synthesized triangle chords. Four REPL layers form the complete 128-BPM, four-bar loop. No audio from the commercial song originally mentioned in the request is embedded.
tr909.licensing: No applicable sample-data permission grant for the selected TR909 files was established in tidal-drum-machines. The repository's open license question is not a license. Public availability, the hardware bank name, or a license for another sample library does not establish CC0 or royalty-free status for these recordings.
actions: Obtain permission/provenance evidence for the actual RolandTR909 recordings, or replace them with self-synthesized percussion or clearly licensed recordings before representing a rendered release as fully cleared.
Label this as an original learning loop, not an authorized commercial-song cover, remix or sound-alike release.
Do not assume the shared percussion or short teaching loop qualifies as exclusive, sufficiently distinctive Content ID reference material.
tr909.bottom_line: The original example is preserved; TR909 sample permission and similarity/claim outcomes remain unverified.

jazz.verdict: Known attribution obligations and partly verified soundfont provenance; actual automated-claim likelihood is unknown.
jazz.rationale: The default piano has a documented attribution license, and the FluidR3 upstream license is verified. These are more concrete permissions than those established for the drum banks, but the samples remain shared/nonexclusive and the exact original-SF2-to-WebAudioFont conversion chain was not fully established. Following known obligations improves release documentation; it does not establish a measured probability of claims.
jazz.inventory: Default `piano`: Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm. `gm_epiano1.n(1)`: `0040_FluidR3_GM_sf2_file`. `gm_acoustic_bass.n(1)`: `0320_FluidR3_GM_sf2_file`. Droplets and underwater noise use built-in `sine` and `brown` synthesis. There are no sampled drum-bank hits or voice recordings in this version.
jazz.licensing: Salamander is CC BY 3.0; include appropriate credit, its license link and a truthful processing description. No rendered-music attribution waiver was verified. CC BY is not ShareAlike and does not by itself place the entire original composition under CC BY. FluidR3's upstream README and COPYING identify MIT, not the separate GPL license for Debian packaging. Preserve its applicable notices when redistributing soundfont/sample data. No requirement to GPL-license this song or publish its composition code was established, and no explicit render-specific attribution waiver was found. The exact conversion-source chain remains partly unverified.
actions: Include this piano credit in the upload description and release credits: Piano samples: Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm, [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), [source](https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3), via Strudel. Samples sequenced and processed in this recording.

Conservatively credit: Electric piano and acoustic bass: FluidR3 by Frank Wen and contributors, [MIT license](https://sources.debian.org/src/fluid-soundfont/3.1-5/COPYING/); WebAudioFont data via Strudel. Retain the complete upstream notice with release documentation; this short credit is not a substitute for notices required when redistributing sample data.

Record the runtime/preset versions used for the actual render, since default sample maps can change. For strict clearance, resolve the remaining conversion provenance or replace those presets with instruments whose chain you can document.
Treat upload permission and Content ID reference eligibility separately. Do not claim exclusive ownership of the shared piano, electric-piano or bass samples.
jazz.bottom_line: Use the provided sample credits and retain the supporting licenses; shared-sample claims and the residual conversion-provenance question are not eliminated.
